labels: the builder's predictions, from the editor's construction (a statement's extent is what tomllib reads as that key alone; every other line is copied, never rewritten) and from local runs of the touched tests while building (seen_before)
seen_before: local runs while building (this laptop, CPU, Python 3.12): the property test passed 3 of 3 runs of 300 draws; each plant failed it 3 of 3 runs (MIME_PLANT_TOML_WRITER=comment, =neighbour). These are why the predictions below are N/N and 0/N: they are fits to what was seen, and the probe is their measurement

dtype: not applicable: no simulation runs; text in, text out
operating_point.platform: GitHub runner 4 vCPU (probe workflow), CPU, Python 3.12
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: drawn TOML documents of 3 to about 40 lines: comments (full lines, line ends, inside arrays), blank lines, LF, CRLF and mixed endings, multi-line basic and literal strings, arrays of tables, inline tables, quoted and dotted keys, sub-tables, a last line with no line feed; [record] written as a table, an inline table, or absent
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: 300 Hypothesis examples a run (no example count changed, no draw filtered), a fresh seed a run (detection_rate.py --hypothesis-seed); CI's profile: no database

gate_1_toml_edit_property.claim: an edit of one key of [record] either leaves every other key equal and every other line byte for byte (comments and line endings included, the key's first-line comment kept on its new first line), or refuses with manifest.write leaving the file byte for byte; and it refuses exactly where the key or [record] is written in a form an edit does not replace

prediction.unit: failing runs of the clean arm, of 200
prediction.why: lines outside the edited statement are copied, and the statement's extent is tomllib's own reading, so no draw the generator makes can move another line; a form it cannot replace is refused before writing

gate_1_toml_edit_property.metric: the property's own oracle: the drawing's spans and tomllib, never the editor's reading

control.plant: comment: a writer that drops the first comment line it writes; neighbour: a writer that also rewrites another key of [record]
control.resolution: one line of the file: a single dropped comment line, a single changed key

gate_1_toml_edit_property.if_wrong: a clean failure is a draw the editor mishandles: fix the editor, or refuse the form and document it, never filter the draw; a missed plant is a generator that too seldom draws a comment or a second key: widen the generator
gate_1_toml_edit_property.cannot_discriminate_if: every draw had no comment line (the comment plant would change nothing) or a single key in [record] (the neighbour plant would change nothing): the rates say whether that happened

bits.cases: tests/sharing/test_push_manifest.py::test_the_folder_loads_and_packs_to_the_same_bytes_whichever_sharing_files_it_holds: a saved toy packed with no sharing file, with mime.toml, with sharing.yaml and with both
